The WayFinding® Experience. Know What's Next.

The WayFinding experience is powered by 24/7 doctors and agentic AI that helps Members understand symptoms, schedule care, and know what to do next—remembering history and context over time.

BOOK A DEMO

Members Can Just Ask Transcarent®. We’ll Take it From Here.

Benefits Navigation

Our AI Care Assistant provides accurate, personalized answers to health and benefits questions—customized to an employer’s benefits and plan design —learning from past interactions to recommend the next best step.

Clinical Guidance

Memory engine remembers what your doctor said. Symptom checking helps Members understand what to do next, with doctors and nurses providing trusted guidance, follow-up, and our virtual expert medical opinions from 2nd.MD.

Care Delivery

Our Members get care on their terms. Intelligent scheduling finds high-quality, in-network options and books visits for them—from 24/7 chat-based care and same-day video visits with board-certified physicians to virtual mental health therapy or in-person care.

WayFinding platform in action

See how Transcarent turns questions into action and to resolution—guiding next steps, scheduling care, and following through—all in One PlaceTM.

  • Personalized care navigation with AI + human support.

  • Symptom checking and intelligent care recommendations

  • AI-powered appointment booking and coordination

  • Memory engine remembers what your doctor said and what you shared, so you don’t have to repeat your story at every visit

  • Reduces complexity and improves scheduling and coordination across care options

A Care Experience that goes beyond the visit
An example of how the WayFinding platform gets people where they need to be on their health and care journey.
Ask the AI Care Assistant
Kara is on vacation and notices some mild wheezing. She opens her app and asks the AI Care Assistant, “I think my asthma is flaring up and I don’t have my inhaler. What should I do?”
Instant guidance
The AI Care Assistant helps Kara assess her symptoms, evaluates urgency, remembers that she prefers virtual care, and guides her to the appropriate next step based on her symptoms, history, and preferences.
Start a visit immediately
Within minutes, Kara completes an intake with specific questions related to her concern and is connected to a board-certified clinician who further evaluates her symptoms.
Kara gets back to enjoying life
Within hours, Kara has answers, treatment, and relief, without having to find or wait for an office visit or navigate multiple services. Being away from home shouldn’t mean that she doesn’t have access to health and care.
Support over time 
WayFinding remembers Kara’s visit, preferences, and care history so future guidance and recommendations feel more personalized. 
Clinician care
Following evidence-based guidelines, the clinician confirms this is likely an asthma flare-up, reviews her medication and history, and electronically sends a prescription for an inhaler to a nearby pharmacy.
Simple access to your everyday care needs
On-demand virtual care, intelligent guidance,  and a connected suite of digital tools help Members navigate healthcare with less friction and more confidence
